definitions.explanation: food that has just been boiled and is still hot

examples.japanese: {茹|ゆ}で{立|た}て⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{卵|たまご}→卵：02222_tamago⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{熱|あつ}い→熱い：09888_atsui⟧。
examples.english: A freshly boiled egg is hot.

examples.japanese: {茹|ゆ}で{立|た}て⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{蕎麦|そば}→蕎麦：14329_soba⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧すすった。
examples.english: I slurped up freshly boiled soba noodles.

examples.japanese: {茹|ゆ}で{立|た}て⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦とうもろこし→とうもろこし：10394_toumorokoshi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{塩|しお}→塩：00887_shio⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦かけて→かける：00854_kakeru⟧⟦{食|た}べた→食べる：00396_taberu⟧。
examples.english: I sprinkled salt on freshly boiled corn and ate it.

notes:
COMPOUNDS:
⟦{茹|ゆ}でる→茹でる：02324_yuderu⟧ (to boil) + ⟦{立|た}て→立てる：01196_tateru⟧ (just done)

COMMON PATTERNS:
The ~⟦{立|た}て→立つ：00758_tatsu⟧ pattern indicates something freshly done:
- ⟦{揚|あ}げ{立|た}て→揚げ立て：08482_agetate⟧ - freshly fried
- ⟦{焼|や}き{立|た}て→焼き立て：08344_yakitate⟧ - freshly baked
- ⟦{出来立|できた}て→出来立て：08343_dekitate⟧ - freshly made
- ⟦{採|と}れ{立|た}て→採れ立て：08484_toretate⟧ - freshly picked

COMMON FOODS:
- {茹|ゆ}で{立|た}て⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{麺|めん}→麺：14644_men⟧ - freshly boiled noodles
- {茹|ゆ}で{立|た}て⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{枝豆|えだまめ}→枝豆：21197_edamame⟧ - freshly boiled edamame
- {茹|ゆ}で{立|た}て⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{卵|たまご}→卵：02222_tamago⟧ - freshly boiled egg
